abstracts.value: An introduction to the basic ideas and methods of Chiral Perturbation Theory is presented. Several phenomenological applications of the effective Lagrangian technique to strong, electromagnetic and weak interactions are discussed.

public_notes.value: 57 pages, plain Tex, 4 figures included in a separate file (uses epsf.tex) Report-no: FTUV/95-4 , IFIC/95-4
